issues.on_page: Other 951,926 (GF rentals 19,269 + other local 68,577; Special Building other local 175,000 + 3599 state categorical 419,826; Activities other local 181,942; Cooperative 87,312)
issues.issue: State money is only 44% of this line (419,826 / 951,926), so no category is above half. Under the 'other' last-resort rule it should stay other with review unless the Cooperative receipts count as intergovernmental. This is already listed in decision_needed.

This line is category capital outlay but is not relabelled 'Capital Outlay: <function>' with printed_label, as the 2026-10-26/28 rule requires. The same applies to detail Special Building '4700 Building', '4700 Other professional services' and '4700 Technology hardware' (p18). user_rules.py may fix this.
